title: Trimble Navigation GNSS Position Structure
description: Structure documentation for Trimble Mobile Manager GNSS position fixes

structure.altitude: number (double) — Height above WGS84 ellipsoid in meters
structure.bearing: number (float) — Direction of travel 0-360° clockwise from north
structure.satellites: integer — Number of satellites used in solution
structure.hrms: number (float) — Horizontal accuracy estimate in meters (RMS)
structure.vrms: number (float) — Vertical accuracy estimate in meters (RMS)

_item.id: integer — Satellite PRN or ID number
_item.used: boolean — Whether included in position solution
_item.gnssSystem: string — Constellation: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, SBAS

diffStatusValues.1: Autonomous — Standard GPS, no corrections (~3-5m accuracy)
diffStatusValues.2: DGPS — Differential GPS corrections applied (~1-2m accuracy)
diffStatusValues.4: RTK Fixed — Integer ambiguity resolved (~1-3cm accuracy)
diffStatusValues.5: RTK Float — Float solution converging (~0.1-0.5m accuracy)

notes: All coordinates use WGS84 reference frame by default
hrms and vrms are RMS (not 2-sigma) accuracy estimates
DOP values below 2.0 indicate excellent satellite geometry
RTK Fixed (diffStatus=4) is required for sub-centimeter precision work
WebSocket v2 includes additional imuOrientation and referenceFrame fields
